name: Gulfport (United States)
description: Blue field charged with a gold disc bearing a blue anchor, surrounded by an arc of seven white stars for the city's seven wards.
history: Gulfport is a port city in Harrison County, Mississippi, and its co-county seat. The flag was adopted on 17 December 2024 (recommended by the Gulfport Flag Commission, set up in January 2024 for the city's 125th anniversary, and unanimously adopted by the city council on 17 December 2024 as the first official flag of Gulfport, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: arc of seven stars for the seven wards
